title: 七哀诗（明月照高楼）
titleEn: Seven Sorrows (The Bright Moon Shines on a High Tower)
author: 曹植
intro: On a moonlit night a wife alone in a high tower pours out her grief: her husband left more than ten years ago, and their lives have drifted as far apart as dust on the road and mud in the water.
analysis: 诗从月光写起：明月照着高楼，月光好像在楼上来回移动，不肯离开——楼上正坐着一位满怀愁思的女子。接着诗人用问答的方式让她自己开口：丈夫离家已经十多年，她一直一个人住。最有名的是“君若清路尘，妾若浊水泥”：丈夫像路上飘起的轻尘，自己像水底沉下的泥，本来是同一种土，现在一浮一沉，再也难以相聚。这种用具体事物来比喻抽象感情的手法叫“比喻”，这里比得又新又准。她甚至想变成一阵西南风，吹进丈夫怀里；可最后一句又冷下来：如果他的怀抱不肯打开，我又能依靠谁？古人常认为曹植是借女子的口，写自己被哥哥曹丕冷落的苦闷，所以这首诗既能读成爱情诗，也能读成政治寄托。
analysisEn: The poem opens with moonlight on a high tower — light that seems to linger and drift back and forth, as if it cannot bear to leave. Up in the tower sits a woman full of sorrow. The poet then lets her speak through a simple question and answer: who is sighing? The wife of a man who left home more than ten years ago, and she has lived alone ever since. The most famous lines compare the couple to dust and mud: he is like light dust rising from a clear road, she is like mud sinking in murky water. Dust and mud are really the same earth, but one floats and one sinks, so how can they ever meet again? Turning a feeling into a concrete picture like this is called bǐyù (metaphor), and this one is both fresh and exact. She wishes she could become the south-west wind and blow straight into his arms — but the last line turns cold again: if his arms will not open, whom can she lean on? Traditional readers believed Cao Zhi was speaking through the wife about himself, pushed aside by his brother the emperor. So the poem can be read as a love lament, or as a quiet political complaint — and it works both ways.
background: Cao Zhi (192–232) was a son of the warlord Cao Cao and one of the most gifted poets of his age. After his elder brother Cao Pi became emperor, Cao Zhi was kept away from court and closely watched; many readers have taken this poem as a veiled picture of that rejection.
pronunciation: 逾 yú；栖 qī；浊 zhuó；谐 xié；“愿为西南风”的“为”读 wéi（变成）；“借问叹者谁”的“谁”诗中读 shuí。
version: 采用《文选》本，全诗八联十六句。“言是客子妻”，有的本子作“宕子妻”或“荡子妻”，意思都是长年在外的人的妻子。《乐府诗集》另收一首文字相近而较长的《怨诗行》，此不涉及。

lines.zh: 明月照高楼，流光正徘徊。
lines.rhythm: 明月/照高楼，流光/正徘徊
lines.py: míng yuè zhào gāo lóu, liú guāng zhèng pái huái
lines.lit: The bright moon shines on the high tower; its flowing light is just lingering, back and forth.
lines.en: The bright moon shines on a high tower, its light drifting, unwilling to leave.

lines.zh: 上有愁思妇，悲叹有余哀。
lines.rhythm: 上有/愁思妇，悲叹/有余哀
lines.py: shàng yǒu chóu sī fù, bēi tàn yǒu yú āi
lines.lit: Up there is a sorrowful, longing wife; her sad sighs carry grief that never ends.
lines.en: Up there a lonely wife is grieving; every sigh trails more sorrow.

lines.zh: 借问叹者谁？言是客子妻。
lines.rhythm: 借问/叹者谁，言是/客子妻
lines.py: jiè wèn tàn zhě shuí, yán shì kè zǐ qī
lines.lit: May I ask who is sighing? She says she is the wife of a traveller.
lines.en: Who is it sighing? “I am the wife of a man who went far away.”

lines.zh: 君行逾十年，孤妾常独栖。
lines.rhythm: 君行/逾十年，孤妾/常独栖
lines.py: jūn xíng yú shí nián, gū qiè cháng dú qī
lines.lit: You left more than ten years ago; I, alone, always stay by myself.
lines.en: “You have been gone more than ten years, and I have slept alone the whole time.

lines.zh: 君若清路尘，妾若浊水泥。
lines.rhythm: 君若/清路尘，妾若/浊水泥
lines.py: jūn ruò qīng lù chén, qiè ruò zhuó shuǐ ní
lines.lit: You are like dust on a clear road; I am like mud in muddy water.
lines.en: You are dust lifting off a clean road, I am mud at the bottom of a cloudy pool.

lines.zh: 浮沉各异势，会合何时谐？
lines.rhythm: 浮沉/各异势，会合/何时谐
lines.py: fú chén gè yì shì, huì hé hé shí xié
lines.lit: Floating and sinking, each takes a different way; when will meeting again be possible?
lines.en: One rises, one sinks — when could the two of us ever come together?

lines.zh: 愿为西南风，长逝入君怀。
lines.rhythm: 愿为/西南风，长逝/入君怀
lines.py: yuàn wéi xī nán fēng, cháng shì rù jūn huái
lines.lit: I wish to become the south-west wind, going far away into your arms.
lines.en: I wish I were the south-west wind, blowing all the long way into your arms.

lines.zh: 君怀良不开，贱妾当何依？
lines.rhythm: 君怀/良不开，贱妾/当何依
lines.py: jūn huái liáng bù kāi, jiàn qiè dāng hé yī
lines.lit: If your arms truly do not open, on whom should I, humble wife, depend?
lines.en: But if your arms stay closed to me, where can I turn?”

words.note: 诗词常用，今天也指“流逝的时光”，如“流光溢彩”。

words.en: to pace back and forth; to linger
words.note: 现代汉语也常用，如“在门口徘徊”。

words.en: a wife who misses her absent husband

words.note: “余”是剩下、不尽的意思，如“余音”。
古诗常用的客气问法，现代说“请问”。

words.en: a man living far from home
words.note: 古语，指长期在外的人；现代说“游子”。
现代汉语“逾期”“年逾七十”还用。

words.en: I (humble word used by a woman)
words.note: 古代女子自称的谦词；今天“妾”只指旧时的小老婆。
今天多指去世或时间流逝，如“消逝”。
古义副词；今天“良”多是“好”的意思，如“良好”。

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 月光照着高楼、徘徊不去，好像也在陪着女子发愁，引出她的长夜相思。
imagery.en: Moonlight lingers on the tower as if keeping the lonely wife company, and opens her long night of longing.

imagery.name: 楼
imagery.zh: 高楼是思妇独居的地方：越高越孤单，也越能望远。
imagery.en: The high tower is where she lives alone — the higher it is, the lonelier, and the farther she can look for him.

imagery.name: 风
imagery.zh: 她愿化作西南风吹进丈夫怀里，风成了她无法实现的相思之路。
imagery.en: She wishes to become the south-west wind and blow into his arms: the wind is the path her longing cannot take.
